estimate_homography: estimate homography matrix from corresponding point sets using RANSAC with local refinement
run_homography_dlt: run homography estimation using DLT formulation with SVD solver on corresponding point pairs
decompose_homography_matrix: decompose homography matrix into rotation, translation, and plane normal candidates
normalize_to_unit: normalize a transformation matrix so its last row and column value equals one
compute_opposite_of_minor: compute the opposite of a specified minor from a batched 3x3 matrix
